description: This file defines the SyntaxError class within the Twig templating engine, specifically handling syntax errors during template lexing or parsing.

classes.name: Twig\Error\SyntaxError
classes.description: A class representing syntax errors that occur during the lexing or parsing of Twig templates, extending the Error class and providing additional suggestions for error messages.

methods.name: addSuggestions
methods.description: Adds suggested corrections to the error message based on possible item matches, using Levenshtein distance and substring checks.
